summary: Dim 31 mai : RISK-ON (58.5% ensemble confidence). S&P 7,580 near ATH. VIX 15.32. DELL +32.8% on AI server blowout. NFP Friday (95K forecast) = event of the week. ISM Prices 85.3 = stagflation signal. AVGO joins $2T club, CRWD/PANW at 52W highs pre-earnings. Gold $4,593 bouncing. BTC $73,446 decoupling from equities (corr 0.18). 30Y at 4.993% approaching 5%. Fed blackout starts June 7.

risks.label: NFP Friday — Sub-100K Risk
risks.detail: Consensus 95K (vs 115K prior). If confirmed = weakest since Oct 2024. Markets price 36% July cut. Miss below 80K → panic, VIX >20, equities -2.5%. Combined with ISM Prices 85.3 = stagflation confirmation.

risks.label: ISM Prices 85.3 — Inflation Won't Quit
risks.detail: 8th consecutive month above 80. Energy ($87 WTI) and logistics costs remain elevated. Hot print >87 with weak NFP = worst-case stagflation scenario. No asset safe except gold and cash.

risks.label: 30Y Yield at 4.993% — 5% Threshold
risks.detail: 30Y millimeters from psychological 5% level. Hot ISM Monday could push through. Bond vigilante risk: 5%+ triggers fiscal austerity talks and equity multiple compression.

risks.label: Market Breadth Narrowing
risks.detail: Only 42% of stocks positive this week. 2 of 11 sectors green (Tech, Financials). Narrowest breadth at ATH since Jan 2020. Historical pattern: 3-5% correction within 4-6 weeks.

risks.label: AVGO Earnings Miss Risk
risks.detail: AVGO reports Wed AMC at $2.12T market cap. Options imply only ±2.9% — too low after DELL +32.8% raised bar. Miss would trigger AI semiconductor complex selloff (NVDA, AMD, MRVL).

risks.label: BoJ Intervention — USD/JPY 159.3
risks.detail: Approaching 160 intervention threshold. Last intervention: 5.5T yen, 5% yen appreciation in 48h. Would crush Nikkei and trigger carry-trade unwinds globally.

events.detail: Forecast 53.3 (vs 52.7 prior). Prices component 85.3. Employment sub-index key for labor market signal. Sets inflation tone for entire week.
